name: tanh_and_mul
semantics: Broadcast x and y to a common shape, then compute tanh(x) multiplied elementwise by y.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Floating-point input tensor passed through tanh.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Floating-point tensor multiplied with tanh(x); broadcasting is allowed.

output: A tensor with the broadcast shape of x and y and values equal to torch.tanh(x) * y.
notes: Start with a simple one-dimensional block-based implementation and explicit masks.
